text: きみの　たたかいは　とても　さんこうに　なるっす！

structure.jp: きみの　たたかいは
とても　さんこうに　なるっす！
structure.en: are really useful to learn from!

patterns.name: 〜です
patterns.explanation: っす is a squashed です used by young sporty men to sound polite to someone above them. なるっす = 'it is, sir'.

patterns.name: 〜になる
patterns.explanation: に before なる shows what something turns into; さんこうになる is the usual way to say something is helpful to learn from. さんこうに　なる = 'it is instructive'.
